patch_description: Gen 45 (double zero-phase SG, lag 0.35, correlation 0.95) and Gen 46 (RTS + three-scale SG bank + gated lead, slope_changes 36, false_reversals 29) each scored 0.65 but on opposite ends of the lag/noise trade-off. No program has combined them. The composition: keep Kalman+RTS with adaptive R and 3σ gating (use solve-based RTS gains for numerical stability), then replace the current double-SG pass with the percentile-gated three-scale SG bank (widest 2*sg_half kills reversals like Gen 46), and use the sigmoid-gated lead on the pure smoothed RTS slope (dropping the noisy gradient blend that drives Gen 45's high reversal count, false_reversals 34-37). This merges Gen 46's reversal suppression with Gen 45's responsiveness, targeting a combined score above 0.65.
